text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging (severity: high) — elevated p95 latency and reduced throughput observed in eu-west-1 inference pool. Affected routes: /v1/generate (gpt-medium-quant). Auto-escalating to SRE Oncall.
SRE Oncall: ack. I'm looking. Any initial metrics?
Maya: seeing p95 jump to ~1.6s (was 400ms), p99 spikes to 3.4s. Throughput down ~25% on the q4 worker ring. Errors minimal, mostly slow tails. Dashboard: https://redwood.prod/observability/dashboards/abcd
Liam: looks like a hot partition on the ring, KV cache pressure high. I'm checking router logs now.
Nico: I can kick a regional routing fallback to alt-model-1 in eu-west-1 to keep latency bounded, will take ~3-5m to roll. Want me to proceed? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
SRE Oncall: please proceed with fallback. Post the mitigation steps you run.
Nico: executing route override now.
```
# apply quick routing override
redwoodctl routes set --region eu-west-1 --route "/v1/generate" --model alt-model-1 --reason "p95 surge"
```
Nico: override applied, propagating.
Maya: reducing batching thresholds for q4 worker ring to lower tail latency. Patch applied.
Anita: CS here — we have two high-traffic customers in eu-west-1 reporting slow responses. Need suggested customer message for status page and direct outreach.
SRE Oncall: Draft status page blurb below, please review/edit then we can publish.
CS Ops: suggested status page update:
"We are investigating elevated request latency for inference requests in our eu-west-1 region affecting a subset of customers. A temporary routing change and runtime configuration tweak are underway to mitigate impact. We will post updates within 15 minutes."
Anita: short direct message for affected customers:
"We're aware of increased latency impacting inference calls in eu-west-1 and have initiated routing failover and runtime optimizations. No data loss expected. We'll follow up with ETA in 15 minutes. — Redwood Support"
Liam: checking infra—no host-level CPU or GPU saturation, it's KV cache eviction churn on the serving runtime. Repro command and recent logs:
```
# sample log tail
[2026-03-15T18:02:10Z] worker-q4-7 WARN kv_cache: eviction=1200, miss_rate=0.42
[2026-03-15T18:02:12Z] router-3 INFO route_override applied for /v1/generate -> alt-model-1
```
Maya: after overrides: p95 down to ~680ms, throughput recovering. p99 still elevated (~1.8s). Monitoring closely.
SRE Oncall: good. Nico, keep the routing override for now and prepare rollback plan once stable.
Nico: acknowledged. I'll watch for error rate regressions and prepare rollback script.
CS Ops: publishing status page update now. Copy of full message used:
"Investigating increased latency in eu-west-1 affecting inference requests. We have activated a temporary routing fallback and runtime tuning to reduce tail latency. Some customers may see improved response times. We'll provide another update shortly."
Anita: I'll send the direct customer note to the two impacted accounts now.
Maya: setting an alert to watch p99 and queue length; also opening a short-term ticket to investigate KV cache tuning for q4 models.
SRE Oncall: current plan: 1) keep routing fallback active 2) monitor for 30m post-stabilization 3) if stable, roll back to normal routing with gradual canary 4) document postmortem owner: Maya
Anita: request for public-facing ETA — what's best estimate?
Nico: optimistic ETA for normal routing to be restored ~45-60m, contingent on p99 trending down.
SRE Oncall: acknowledged. I'll leave oncall until handoff at shift end. If anyone is taking over, speak now.
Liam: I can take the overnight watch at +1 handoff. I'll be available for rollback if needed.
SRE Oncall: thanks — handoff noted to Liam. Everyone, add any follow-ups here.
Anita: thanks team, I'll follow up with customers after the 15m status update. :thumbsup:
Liam: p99 trending down to 1.2s at 18:35 UTC. Throughput near baseline. Proceeding to prepare controlled rollback plan (canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%).
Maya: canary looks healthy at 5%, no tail regressions. Approving 25% canary.
Nico: 25% in place, monitoring.
SRE Oncall: after 30m stable at 25%, roll to 100%.
Nico: 100% rollback completed. Final metrics: p95 ~420ms, p99 ~580ms, throughput normal. Closing mitigation window.
CS Ops: status page update: "Service recovered in eu-west-1. We will perform a follow-up investigation and post a postmortem within 72 hours."
Anita: sent customer follow-up with summary and invite to a tech sync if they want more details.
SRE Oncall: great work. Postmortem owner: Maya. Timeline and actions captured. I'll file incident ticket.
Maya: filing postmortem and linking playbook changes for KV cache handling.
incident-bot: Incident transitioned to resolved. Incident ID: IR-20260315-3420. Please add any missing notes to the ticket.
:partyparrot: :tada:
